name: suite
awake: You awaken in a tavern suite, enjoy a leisurely bath, then saunter down to the common room to break your fast.
sleep: After a sumptuous meal, you enjoy a lazy bath, flirting with the attendant, then lay yourself down on the down filled mattresses.  You fall asleep instantly.

name: room
awake: You awaken in a small room, listen for a moment to the sounds of the morning crowd tromping around, then get up.
sleep: You eat dinner, down a pint, wash your hands and face, then lay down on the hay filled mattress and close your eyes.

name: floor
awake: You awaken on the tavern floor with the taste of smoke in your mouth.  You have to scramble to evade being trampled by the morning crowd, just arriving for breakfast.
sleep: You bundle up your cloak and find a relatively unsoiled section of floor to sleep on.

name: town
awake: You crawl from the alley where your body has been laying all night, stretch your newly revived limbs, and go about your business.
sleep: You drop dead in the town.

name: fields
awake: You awaken in a grassy meadow, soaked head to toe in morning dew.
sleep: You set camp on a grassy knoll, then watch the the sun set in radiant red and gold.

name: forest
awake:
You awaken under a bush, itching horribly from insect bites.

	Why in the name of heaven did you decide to come to this wretched place?
sleep: You find a hollow tree, drive out the spiders and squirrels, then hole up in a cramped position.

name: mound
awake:
You awaken under a bench in the Gobble Inn.  You itch horribly from numerous insect bites.

	Why in the name of heaven did you decide to come to this wretched place?
sleep: You sink to the bottom of degradation.  Being utterly broke and exhausted you slump into a corner of the Gobble Inn.  You have to squabble with a tame berzerker for a spot near the fire.

name: cot
awake: You awaken on a cramped and smelly cot. Smidgen Crumb is eyeing your purse with a calculated stare.
sleep: You shell out a small fortune for a small and suspiciously odiferous cot.  You down your meal of uncooked radishes, then pull the thin covers over your shivering form

name: hills
awake: You roll over and nearly fall off a cliff before snapping to your senses in a heady rush of adrenalin.
sleep: You find a drafty cave that stinks of large predators.  You huddle next to a make-shift fire and descend into a nightmarish stupor.

name: docks
awake: You come to consciousness on a rain swept beach.  After walking for several hours, you arrive back at the docks.

name: dunjeon
awake: You come to awareness in darkness with a foul stench. You crawl towards a distant light, finally emerging from a sewer into the castle.

name: limbo
awake:
Your character has failed to load properly. Please report this error to the System Operator. 
	We RECOMMEND that you reload the game (hit refresh/reload in your browser), then wait five minutes before trying to load your hero again.
	(You Have Awakened In Limbo)
sleep: You have fallen into LIMBO, that strange region that can only be entered via programming errors. You go to sleep with a strong urge to report your problem to the world builders...
